mapper.sql: cr.id AS cr_id, cr.order_id AS cr_order_id, cr.checkitem_id AS cr_checkitem_id, ci.name AS checkitem_name, cr.result_status AS cr_result_status, cr.report_time AS cr_report_time, cdr.id AS cdr_id, cdr.cireport_id AS cdr_cireport_id, cdr.checkitemdetailed_id AS cdr_checkitemdetailed_id, cid.name AS detail_name, cid.unit AS detail_unit, cid.normal_range AS detail_normal_range, cdr.result_value AS cdr_result_value, cdr.is_abnormal AS cdr_is_abnormal, cdr.create_time AS cdr_create_time
FROM cireport cr LEFT JOIN checkitem ci ON cr.checkitem_id = ci.id LEFT JOIN cidetailedreport cdr ON cdr.cireport_id = cr.id LEFT JOIN checkitemdetailed cid ON cdr.checkitemdetailed_id = cid.id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cireport (order_id, checkitem_id, result_status, report_time) VALUES (#{orderId}, #{checkitemId}, #{resultStatus}, #{reportTime})
